reviews.title: Amazing Card
reviews.comment: Bought this card back in July to replace a 6800 XT and I'm finally writing a review almost 6 months later. I'm so glad I upgraded when I did, given current prices. Also really glad I went with this card. It runs absolutely everything I care to play. Everything. At absurd fps. Warframe runs at nearly 200fps in most situations at max settings 3440x1440 Ultrawide. Stalker 2 runs great (with a little scaling), Diablo 4, RDR2 of course looks amazing, Cyberpunk... Name it, this card will run it. I have it paired with a 9800X3D. This combo is a beast of a rig, and it looks awesome IRL too. 10/10, would buy again. I will say, be warned that this card is mega huge. I ended up upgrading my entire system because one thing led to another. I realized this card wouldn't fit in my old case, so I bought a bigger one. Realized my old power supply probably should be trusted with it, so I bought a newer one. Remember that I had faulty ram, so I went looking for new and ended up upgrading to DDR5, getting a new mobo, a new CPU... I went down a rabbit hole. Don't be like me, but so get this card! It's great!
reviews.author: J. Smitts

reviews.title: Good performance, bad in vertical(rotated 90 degrees with the motherboard) orientation
reviews.comment: Great card with great performance, this doesn’t work well in a vertical mount seen in cases such as Thermaltake the tower 500. In those cases it overheats. Other than that it’s a big card, but good value for the money if it works well in your system.
